title: StitchTemplate
description: A reusable stitch template for creating beads with default values and field substitutions

name.description: Unique template name (filename without .md, or explicit name in frontmatter)

description.description: Human-readable description of what the template is for

scope.description: Template scope: 'global' for ~/.hoop/templates, project name for <project>/.hoop/templates

kind.description: Default stitch kind (task, fix, investigation, genesis, review)

priority.description: Default priority (0-4, higher is more urgent)

fields.description: Field definitions that surface as form inputs

body.description: Template body with {{field}} placeholders for substitution
